description:
Compute the amortisation schedule for a specific mortgage package using that package's real effective rates. Returns loan facts (`context`), the per-tier breakdown (`periods`), rate structure, totals and the per-year schedule (`annual`).

Required: `packageId` from `recommend_packages`, `loanAmount` (SGD) and `tenureYears`. Optional: `includeMonthly: true` fills `monthly`; `formats` (`["pdf"]`, `["xlsx"]` or both) adds download URLs under `documents`; `firstPaymentDate` (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to next month).

Not for hypothetical rates: use `calculate_mortgage_repayment` for a what-if rate the borrower holds no package for.

firstPaymentDate.description: First repayment month as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to next month.

formats.description: Document formats to generate and upload (pdf, xlsx); the resulting download URLs are returned under `documents`. Omit/empty for data only.

includeMonthly.description: Include the full month-by-month schedule (`monthly[]`) in the response. Omitted/false returns an empty `monthly[]` to keep the payload small.

loanAmount.description: Amount borrowed under this package, in SGD.

maskBankIdentity.description: When true and the bank has maskIdentity set, replace the bank name with "Confidential Rate" and hide the logo in generated documents.

tenureYears.description: Repayment period of the loan, in years; the schedule amortises over it.

name: calculate_package_schedule

annual.description: Per-year rollup across the full tenure.

endingBalance.description: Outstanding balance at year end, in SGD.

interestPaid.description: Interest paid during the year, in SGD.

principalPaid.description: Principal repaid during the year, in SGD.

totalPaid.description: Total paid during the year (principal + interest), in SGD.

lockInYears.description: Lock-in period in years, or null.

packageId.description: The package this schedule was computed for.

propertyLabel.description: Property type/status label, e.g. "Private (completed)", or null.

pdfUrl.description: Public PDF download URL, or null if not generated.

xlsxUrl.description: Public XLSX download URL, or null if not generated.

monthly.description: Full month-by-month schedule; empty unless `includeMonthly`/`formats` requested.

closingBalance.description: Balance at the end of the month, in SGD.

cumulativeInterest.description: Interest paid to date, in SGD.

cumulativePrincipal.description: Principal repaid to date, in SGD.

interest.description: Interest portion of the payment, in SGD.

openingBalance.description: Balance at the start of the month, in SGD.

payment.description: Total payment this month, in SGD.

principal.description: Principal portion of the payment, in SGD.

rate.description: Annual rate in effect, as a decimal fraction (0.035 = 3.5% p.a.).

rateLabel.description: Rate description in effect this month.

yearIndex.description: 1-based loan year this month falls in.

monthlyPayment.description: Monthly instalment during this tier, in SGD.

periods.description: Compact per-rate-tier breakdown (monthly payment, principal/interest, balance).

endingBalance.description: Outstanding balance at the end of this tier, in SGD.

interestPaid.description: Total interest paid during this tier, in SGD.

monthlyPayment.description: Monthly instalment during this tier, in SGD.

months.description: Number of months this tier spans.

principalPaid.description: Total principal repaid during this tier, in SGD.

rate.description: Annual interest rate for the tier, as a decimal fraction (0.035 = 3.5% p.a.).

rateLabel.description: Human-readable rate label, e.g. "Fixed" or "3M SORA + 1.00%".

year.description: 1-based loan year this rate tier begins in.

label.description: Tier label, e.g. "Year 1–2 (fixed)" or "Year 4 onward · 3M SORA".

rate.description: Annual rate for the tier, as a decimal fraction (0.035 = 3.5% p.a.).

asOfDate.description: Date of the benchmark quote (ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD).

rate.description: Latest benchmark rate, as a decimal fraction (0.0356 = 3.56% p.a.).

referenceIndex.description: Benchmark the first floating tier is priced off, or null for fully fixed packages.

interestPctOfLoan.description: Total interest as a fraction of the loan (0.42 = 42% of principal).

totalInterest.description: Total interest over the full tenure, in SGD.

totalPaid.description: Total of all payments over the tenure, in SGD.

totalPrincipal.description: Total principal repaid (equals the loan amount), in SGD.

title: Calculate package payment schedule
